name: Flowers for My Still Beloved
source:
In Hinomori City, a prestigious academy accepts girls from elementary through high school to educate and guide them toward their destined paths. As one of the steps towards that goal, girls entering the junior high division get paired with girls from the high school division, bonding together to learn and teach the ways of proper womanhood.

Manatsu, a girl who's been in the school since elementary and has only sparingly interacted with boys, is best friends with Kimi, a transfer student escaping the cruelty of them at another. Through lucky chance, they get assigned the same high schooler as their mentor.

But striking though she is, their upperclassman isn't all that she seems. The pariah of her class, Kimi is enchanted by her and her woes immediately, but Manatsu isn't so convinced.

Good thing that that the love between friends lasts forever.

[From [url=https://dainadjakyou.itch.io/flowers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在日之森市，一所著名的学院招收从小学到高中的女孩，以教育和引导她们走向注定的道路。作为实现这一目标的步骤之一，进入初中组的女孩与高中组的女孩配对，共同学习和教授正确的女性之道。

真夏是一个从小学就开始上学的女孩，很少与男孩互动，她和转学生基米是最好的朋友，而基米是一名转校生，为了躲避他们的残酷对待。幸运的是，他们被分配到了与导师相同的高中生。

尽管她很引人注目，但他们的学长并不像她看上去的那样。基美是班上的贱民，她立刻就被她和她的不幸迷住了，但真夏并不那么相信。

好在朋友之间的爱情能够天长地久。

[来自[url=https://dainadjakyou.itch.io/flowers]itch.io[/url]]
